nodes.description: Immutable-like internal interface reference to the external IEtherFreaker contract at 0x3A27..., used for pricing and token-count reads.
Immutable payable address set from tx.origin in the constructor; receives all contract balance in birthSet.
Immutable keccak256 of FreakerBirther creation code bound with bytes12(0) and tx.origin, used for CREATE2 address derivation.
Interface reference in the one-shot birther contract pointing at the IEtherFreaker instance.
Transaction origin EOA used to derive owner and initCodeHash, making ownership and CREATE2 salts origin-dependent.
Block timestamp mixed into the pseudo-random hash used by _randomishIntLessThan.
Sets owner from tx.origin and computes initCodeHash from FreakerBirther creation code and tx.origin.
Public view that sums the cost of the next 8 birth certificates read from the external freaker contract.
Public view that brute-forces CREATE2 salts to find the best fortune per species and estimates total cost and gas.
Payable entry point that validates msg.value against birthingCost, deploys 8 FreakerBirther contracts via CREATE2 and forwards all balance to owner.
Internal view deriving the deterministic CREATE2 deployment address from address(this), salt and initCodeHash.
Internal view returning a timestamp-seeded hash modulo n, the pseudo-randomness source for species and fortune.
Payable constructor that forwards msg.value into _etherFreaker.birthTo and then self-destructs to the owner.
External payable call _etherFreaker.birthTo{value: msg.value}(owner) executed before selfdestruct.
selfdestruct(owner) inside the birther constructor, destroying the contract and sending its balance out.
Low-level owner.call{value: address(this).balance}("") performed after deployments, external call with state and balance effects.
new FreakerBirther{salt: bytes32(creationSalt), value: cost}(owner) CREATE2 deployments inside the birthSet loop.
External interface calls numTokens(), birthCertificates(i) and middlePrice() on the untrusted freaker contract.
Inline assembly returndatacopy/revert(0, returndatasize()) used to bubble up failure of the owner value call.
Payable owner parameter of the FreakerBirther constructor, recipient of msg.value and selfdestruct.
Minimum fortune threshold used in findSet to decide which candidates count.
Minimum fortune threshold passed to birthSet selection logic.
Salt value hashed into the CREATE2 address computation.
Domain-separation bytes32 salt ("species"/"fortune") mixed into the random hash.
Derived CREATE2 address mixed into the random hash.
Modulus bounding the returned pseudo-random value.
Loop counter salt incremented until 8 qualifying freakers are found in findSet.
Counter of qualifying freakers found so far in findSet.
In-memory FreakerBirtherInfo[8] accumulating best creationSalt/fortune per species in findSet.
Accumulated cost of 8 births computed from middlePrice in findSet.
Returned gas consumption of the search loop in findSet.
Snapshot of gasleft() before the findSet search loop.
Per-iteration birth cost (middlePrice * 1005 / 1000 + 1) in findSet.
Loop counter salt incremented until 8 qualifying freakers are found in birthSet.
Counter of qualifying freakers found so far in birthSet.
In-memory FreakerBirtherInfo[8] holding selected CREATION2 salts and fortunes used for deployment.
Per-iteration ether value forwarded to each CREATE2 birther deployment.
Sum of certificate prices (with 0.5% markup and >=1 rounding) returned by birthingCost.

edges.reason: tx.origin is read in the Freakonomics constructor to derive privileged ownership and hash material.
owner state variable is assigned from tx.origin, tying privileged recipient to the origin EOA.
tx.origin is packed into the initCodeHash, so CREATE2 salts depend on the caller origin.
Constructor initializes the _etherFreaker interface reference used later for external calls.
birthingCost reads _etherFreaker to query numTokens and birthCertificates prices.
Cost computation depends on results of external untrusted view calls on the freaker contract.
block.timestamp seeds the randomness hash in _randomishIntLessThan (timestamp dependency).
findSet calls the randomish helper to derive species and fortune.
findSet calls _findCaller to derive the CREATE2 address for each salt.
findSet reads middlePrice from the external _etherFreaker interface.
findSet writes the selected salts and fortunes into the in-memory freakers array.
birthSet requires msg.value to be at least birthingCost().
birthSet calls _findCaller to obtain candidate addresses for the CREATE2 salt search.
birthSet uses the timestamp-seeded randomish helper for species and fortune selection.
birthSet reads middlePrice from _etherFreaker while pricing the deployments.
birthSet deploys eight FreakerBirther contracts via CREATE2 with the discovered salts.
After the CREATE2 deployments birthSet forwards the whole balance to owner with an external value call.
Failure of the owner value call is bubbled up through the inline assembly revert.
birthSet branches into the assembly revert path when the owner call returns false.
owner is the destination of the low-level value call, the state-dependent external transfer target.
FreakerBirther constructor passes msg.value into the external birthTo call.
FreakerBirther constructor ends with selfdestruct to the owner supplied at creation time.
The birther constructor invokes the _etherFreaker interface stored in the contract.
_findCaller hashes initCodeHash with address(this) and the salt to derive the CREATE2 address.
birthSet selection outcome depends on block.timestamp through the randomish helper.
findSet search result depends on block.timestamp through the randomish helper.

normalization_plan.reason: owner parameter is used only inside FreakerBirther.constructor for birthTo and selfdestruct.
minimumFortune parameter is consumed only by the findSet selection loop.
minimumFortune parameter is consumed only by the birthSet selection loop.
creationSalt parameter is used only within _findCaller's CREATE2 hash.
salt parameter is only an input to _randomishIntLessThan's hash.
caller parameter is only an input to _randomishIntLessThan's hash.
n parameter is the modulus applied inside _randomishIntLessThan.
local creationSalt counter exists only inside the findSet search loop.
local foundFreakers counter exists only inside findSet.
local freakers array is written and returned only by findSet.
local totalCost accumulator belongs to findSet's pricing loop.
local gasSpent return value is computed only in findSet.
local initialGas snapshot is taken only in findSet.
local cost value is computed only in the findSet loop.
local creationSalt counter exists only inside the birthSet search loop.
local foundFreakers counter exists only inside birthSet.
local freakers array holds the salts used by birthSet's CREATE2 deployments.
local cost is the per-deployment value used by birthSet's CREATE2 calls.
totalCost return accumulator belongs to birthingCost's price summation.
